summary_en: 3,700,000 shares, 0.90% of shares outstanding (ex-treasury), ¥3.0B upper limit, open-market method, execution window 5 August 2026 to 30 September 2026.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On 4 August 2026, NAGASE & CO., LTD.'s board of directors resolved to acquire up to 3,700,000 shares of its own common stock within a total budget of ¥3.0 billion. The acquisition will be conducted via open-market purchases between 5 August 2026 and 30 September 2026. The 3,700,000 shares represent 0.90% of the 410,752,309 shares outstanding (excluding treasury). The company stated that the acquisition supports its mid-term plan "Walk the Talk 2028", which positions ongoing dividend increases and opportunistic treasury stock acquisition as core shareholder-return strategies. The buyback is intended to improve capital efficiency and enhance enterprise value, taking into account current market valuation of the stock, the company's financial condition, and its investment capacity for growth.
